qemu_command: qemu-system-x86_64 -machine q35 -accel tcg,tb-size=256 -cpu max -smp 1 -m 1024 -display none -no-reboot -serial stdio -monitor none -qmp unix:/home/ubuntu/qnx-host/guest/qmp.sock,server=on,wait=off -drive file=/home/ubuntu/qnx-host/guest/guest.qcow2,format=qcow2,if=virtio -drive file=/home/ubuntu/qnx-host/guest/seed.iso,format=raw,media=cdrom,readonly=on -nic user,model=virtio-net-pci -virtfs local,path=/home/ubuntu/qnx-host/guest/shared,mount_tag=hostshare,security_model=mapped-xattr,id=shared
